name: Affiliate stats
oneLiner: a dark glass affiliate dashboard turns in out of depth: the referral link chip, clicks and signups count up in their tiles, earnings climbs big while its area chart draws with a riding dot, then a green Payout sent chip stamps on with the amount and a ring
say: when the speaker says a link pays them or what a referral earned ('I just share my link and it pays me', 'that one link made me 2k last month'): cut in on 'link', the payout chip stamps on the amount
